# Marco Doria

> AI-assisted content operations consultant for SaaS and eCommerce companies. Human-led operations, AI-augmented execution. Based in Sicily, Italy — remote-native.

## Services

- [Content Ops Audit](https://marcodoria.consulting/#work-with-me): Structured diagnosis of your editorial operation — brief quality, workflow, output measurement, community intelligence layer. Includes optional AI search visibility add-on. Delivered as a written report with a 90-day action plan.
- [Fractional Content Operations](https://marcodoria.consulting/#work-with-me): Ongoing editorial ops leadership without a full-time hire. Workflow governance, editorial QA, brief templates, performance tracking.
- [Content Intelligence](https://marcodoria.consulting/#work-with-me): Biweekly digest of content opportunities — trending topics, competitor gaps, community signals, search demand shifts.

## Background

- [The full story](https://marcodoria.consulting/story.html): Ten years in content — from translation to publisher-side editorial to AI-assisted content operations.
- [Content Operations Audit: The Gentle Meeple](https://marcodoria.consulting/case-study-gentle-meeple.html): A real audit run on my own newsletter — 90 days of data, 8 posts, full pipeline from brief to distribution. Every number verified.

## Key facts

- 10+ years in performance content: translation, editorial management, affiliate content ops, AI-augmented systems
- Positioning: "The brief is the most expensive document your team produces. Almost no one treats it that way."
- ICP: SaaS and eCommerce companies, 20–200 people, growth stage
- Entry point: Content Ops Audit (€500–1,200)
- Proof of work: job-search-agent (GitHub, live since April 2026), Gentle Meeple AI editorial pipeline
